name: Serra Paragon
oracle_text:
Flying
Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life."
blocked_sentences: Once during each of your turns, you may play a land from your graveyard or cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard. If you do, it gains "When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life."

needs.what: a static graveyard play permission covering both land plays and permanent-spell casts (mana value 3 or less) from your graveyard, restricted to your turns, with ONE shared once-per-turn allowance across the two kinds of play
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cast_from_graveyard` (with affects_spells and max_per_turn) and `play_lands_from_graveyard` are separate statics with separate ledgers; writing both would allow a land AND a spell each turn, twice what the card allows, and `play_lands_from_graveyard` carries no rate limit at all

needs.what: the permanent played or cast through that permission gains a quoted triggered ability ("When this permanent is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and you gain 2 life") that persists on the resulting permanent independently of the source
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `grant_ability` grants to objects chosen by an effect or a static filter over printed characteristics; nothing marks the object that used the graveyard permission and hands it an ability, and `cast_gains_keywords` / `mana_grant` give keywords only, not a triggered ability, and never to a land play
